summary: Tested the per-user, per-tab sidebar visibility feature end to end. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed. Defaults for /settings/tabs/me are correct for yusuf, bd and the 4 other members, and X-View-As impersonation is respected. GET/PUT /settings/tabs is limited to yusuf: other users and yusuf while impersonating get 403, yusuf editing himself gets 400, an unknown user gets 404, a missing user_id gets 422, unknown tab keys are dropped, and overrides persist. Frontend: every requested flow passed. Rupali's sidebar is filtered and empty sections disappear. Direct URLs to the 8 hidden pages and to /tab-visibility redirect to /dashboard. bd sees all 8 restricted tabs but not Tab Visibility. Yusuf sees 20 nav items including Tab Visibility. The Tab Manager table has 6 rows; yusuf's row is locked with disabled toggles and no All/None buttons. Toggling time ON and sop OFF for u_arjun persists across reload, and rupali then sees Time Tracker while /sop redirects. All/None work (kalpesh with None sees only Dashboard). In View-as the sidebar shows the member's tabs, the Tab Visibility nav is hidden and its route redirects. The mobile drawer is filtered. Defaults were restored by deleting the settings doc id 'tab_visibility'.

minor.issue: Tab visibility is only enforced in the frontend. Rupali (leads/clients/kpi hidden) still gets 200 from GET /api/leads, /api/clients, /api/kpi and /api/hr/policies. This may be acceptable because the requirement was about UI/URL blocking, but hidden data can still be read through the API.

action_items: Optional: enforce tab visibility on the backend data endpoints (leads, clients, kpi, hr, leaves, time, ai, vibes) if hidden data must be truly blocked
critical_code_review_comments: TabsProvider: right after a login or View-as switch within the app, there can be one render where ready=true with the previous user's hidden set (setReady(false) runs in an effect). This could briefly flash a hidden page. Consider resetting hidden/ready synchronously when user.id changes, or tracking which user the loaded set belongs to.
TabManager: there is no loading state, and quick consecutive toggles build on the closure's u.visible (this read the latest row in testing because the row re-renders, but optimistic saves can race).
PUT /settings/tabs replaces the user's whole override map instead of merging. That works with the current UI, which always sends the full map, but it is worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Test overrides for u_arjun, u_priya and u_meera were created, then removed by deleting settings doc id 'tab_visibility'.
